lowyna_1.m: Whoa, you look small. I must be seeing things. That last batch I did must have gotten stronger than usual.
r: What are you people doing here?
Can I look at your wares again?
I see a lot of potion bottles around. Is that what you do?

lowyna_3.m: I am Lowyna, of course. These people that you see in here and in the other huts, you could say that we're sort of in the same ... family.
r: What are you people doing here?

lowyna_4.m: What smell? I can't smell anything out of the ordinary. It must be you.
r: What are you people doing here?

lowyna_6.m: I really shouldn't be discussing this with you. You look way too inexperienced for this.
r: Two-teeth sent me to get some rat poison.

lowyna_8.m: I'm amazed he's still around, good old two-teeth.

lowyna_9.m: For his sake, I'll let you browse my wares.

lowyna.10: Among some huts to the west of the Duleian road, I met a man called two-teeth. He wants me to go get him something called Rat poison from Lowyna. I can find her in one of the other huts.
lowyna.20: Lowyna will now allow me to trade with her.
lowyna.40: I have given some rat poison to two-teeth.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
